name: Clorox

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (The Clorox Company logo, 2021.svg)

description: Clorox sells household and professional products, mostly in the US (84% of FY2026 net sales): Clorox bleach and disinfecting cleaners, Pine-Sol, Glad bags and wraps, Fresh Step cat litter, Kingsford charcoal, Hidden Valley dressings, Brita water filters and Burt's Bees. It sells to mass retailers, grocers, warehouse clubs and dollar stores through a direct sales force and brokers; Walmart alone was 26% of FY2026 net sales. In April 2026 it bought GOJO Industries, maker of Purell hand sanitizer, which now operates as Clorox Purell, and it sold its Better Health VMS vitamins business in FY2025. FY2026 net sales fell 5% to $6,720M and gross margin fell to 42.3% from 45.2%, after retailers had pulled orders forward in FY2025 ahead of an ERP system change.

businessLines.name: Health and Wellness
businessLines.how: Retailers buy bleach and cleaners on repeat orders, and professional customers (healthcare and institutions) buy through B2B channels; Purell (GOJO) adds hand-sanitizer sales.
businessLines.description: US cleaning, disinfecting and sanitizing: Clorox, Clorox2, Pine-Sol, Scentiva, Tilex, Liquid-Plumr, Formula 409; Purell and GOJO skin sanitization (from April 2026); CloroxPro professional products.

operatingProfit.note: Segment adjusted EBIT (Clorox's segment profit measure). FY2025 $840M on $2,697M sales (flat sales, EBIT -19%). Share is of the four segments' $1,191M (sum computed) before Corporate and Other (-$161M).

businessLines.name: Household
businessLines.how: Retailers buy trash bags, litter and charcoal on repeat orders; raw-material costs (the 10-K lists resins, corrugated cardboard and other commodities) drive profit.
businessLines.description: US bags and wraps (Glad), cat litter (Fresh Step, Scoop Away) and grilling (Kingsford).

operatingProfit.note: Segment adjusted EBIT. FY2025 $325M on $2,001M sales (sales -11%).

businessLines.name: Lifestyle
businessLines.how: Grocery, mass and club retailers buy salad dressings, water filters and lip care on repeat orders.
businessLines.description: US food (Hidden Valley dressings, dips, seasonings and sauces), Brita water filtration and Burt's Bees natural personal care.

operatingProfit.note: Segment adjusted EBIT. FY2025 $290M on $1,303M sales (sales -14%).

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Local retailers and distributors buy the same household brands; results depend on local currencies and pricing.
businessLines.description: Products sold outside the US: laundry additives and home care (Clorox, Poett, Pine-Sol, Clorinda, Chux), Glad, Fresh Step and Ever Clean litter, Brita; operations in about 25 countries and sales in about 95 markets.

operatingProfit.note: Segment adjusted EBIT. FY2025 $110M on $1,065M sales (sales +5%).
